name: Lean Default (stronger models only)
server: Any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible server, or a command line
models: Any model strong enough to do a whole job from one look at the page
notes: For a strong model that is dear to call, hosted or on a command line. The model must be able to see a picture of the page, be made to answer with a tool call, and do a whole job from one look at it: a weaker model plans badly on this harness and leaves work undone, so use Default for those. It gets a short job description and only the calls a turn can make, a typed page as its text with no picture, and gives a job's words or sketch in the plan itself, so most jobs are one call and a fraction of the tokens Default uses.
